purpose: Original Kuizer logo concepts. Reference images guide materials and craftsmanship, not the identity of the marks.

concepts.name: Prism K
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one original premium desktop app icon for Kuizer, a developer disk cleanup utility. Direction: PRISM K. Output square 1024 x 1024, transparent background. References attached are style references ONLY for the meticulous sculpted material quality, beveling, reflected light, softly grained surfaces. Do not copy their marks. Subject: a strong recognizable uppercase K monogram sculpted from three thick interlocking translucent glacier-blue and cyan glass pieces, inside a deep petrol-teal rounded-square machined glass tile. Near frontal view, slight view of top and right bevel, centered. K has a vertical stem and two beautiful broad diagonal arms; precise clear letterform. Icy cyan highlights on upper-left beveled edges, dark teal depth and subtle aqua caustics, fine frosted grain, soft contact shadows, physically believable internal reflections, restrained blue-white studio speculars. The overall squircle occupies 82 percent of the image width with generous transparent margin on all sides. Artisan macOS icon rendered like an expensive miniature physical object, high-quality 3D product rendering, beautifully art-directed. No text, no labels, no watermark, no surrounding scene, no extra symbols. One icon only, not a sheet or presentation. Preserve genuine alpha transparency around tile.

concepts.name: Sweep
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one original premium desktop application icon for Kuizer, a tool that reclaims disk space by sweeping away developer build caches. Direction: SWEEP. Square 1024 x 1024 output on a genuinely transparent background. Attached images are material and craftsmanship references ONLY, not logos to reproduce. Subject: a single thick, sculptural satin-glass ribbon forming an open circular sweeping motion, with its tapered upward right end transforming into three small detached clean beveled blocks as though sweeping clutter into order. The graceful swoosh almost closes a circle with an airy negative center. Ribbon transitions from warm luminous ivory at upper left through apricot and vivid tangerine to deep coral red at its lower right. Nest it on a warm pearl ceramic rounded-square tile with a thin brushed champagne metal bevel. Meticulous real 3D geometry, glass and ceramic physically based materials, fine frosted microtexture, warm reflections, illuminated thin edges, strong soft cast shadows, subtle specular highlights. Restrained luxurious object, not cartoon. Frontal icon view, subtle top and side bevel visible. Tile occupies 82 percent of image width, centered with generous transparent margin. No text, no watermark, no logos from reference, no extra unrelated objects, one icon only. Match the expensive highly detailed macOS icon rendering quality of the attached references.

concepts.name: Clean Slate
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. One original premium desktop app icon for Kuizer, a developer machine disk cleanup utility. Direction: CLEAN SLATE. Output square 1024 x 1024, genuinely transparent background. Attached images are references for their high-quality 3D icon craftsmanship, not subjects to copy. A beautiful solid physical eraser with two diagonally joined material sections, the upper section soft translucent lavender glass and the lower section milky luminous porcelain, floating diagonally from lower left to upper right in front of a rich violet frosted glass rounded-square tile. A narrow polished chrome band at the material join with delicate engraved parallel grooves. Eraser is thick and softly beveled, a compelling tactile simple form, with precise finely grained surfaces. A few tiny geometric translucent violet crumbs below its lower tip suggest removing digital clutter. Tile has multiple nested bevels, dark purple depth at its bottom edge, glowing lavender rim lights, soft inner shadow and real physically based reflections. Expensive miniature product photography, beautifully lit from upper left, frontal view with slight thickness visible, clear icon silhouette. Purple, lilac, silver and porcelain palette. Tile occupies 82 percent of frame with generous transparent margin around complete icon. One icon only. No letters, text, labels, watermark, checkerboard, extra unrelated objects. Genuine alpha around icon.
